lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's five hundred twenty-seven? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 527? Nope!

lines.text: How many whole numbers from one to one thousand are multiples of four, six or nine?
lines.caption: How many whole numbers from 1 to 1000 are multiples of 4, 6 or 9?

lines.text: Count each: two hundred fifty, one hundred sixty-six, and one hundred eleven.
lines.caption: Count each: 250, 166, and 111.

lines.text: But twelve is in two circles. Adding counts it twice!
lines.caption: But 12 is in two circles. Adding counts it twice!

lines.text: So take away the multiples of twelve, eighteen and thirty-six: one hundred sixty-five.
lines.caption: So take away the multiples of 12, 18 and 36: 165.

lines.text: Now thirty-six, in all three, isn't counted at all. Add back those twenty-seven!
lines.caption: Now 36, in all three, isn't counted at all. Add back those 27!

lines.text: Altogether, that's three hundred eighty-nine numbers!
lines.caption: Altogether, that's 389 numbers!

lines.text: The trap was five hundred twenty-seven.
lines.caption: The trap was 527.

lines.text: Did you get three hundred eighty-nine? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 389? Tell me below!
